compiled_state.title: As a developer, classifier-flagged review overlays are mechanically required to produce findings
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add overlay-dispatch verification to the compliance verifier. When the REVIEW classifier flags one or more overlays (security/performance/test_quality/accessibility), the verifier confirms each flagged overlay's findings file is present; missing findings file triggers the same block as a missing wrapper artifact. Subsumes bug `94e8-9f91` (overlay flags ignored).

**Why**: SC1 (overlay branch) and SC6 (94e8-9f91 regression) — the user reporter's failing agent had been silently skipping classifier-flagged overlay dispatches across an entire session.

**Scope**:
- IN: an overlay registry file (path TBD; conventional under `.claude/scripts/dso/` or plugin docs) that lists currently-supported overlay types and their findings file naming; verifier reads the registry rather than hardcoding overlay names; verifier reads classifier output, computes expected overlay findings files for flagged overlays, blocks commit on any missing.
- OUT: changing overlay agent definitions; changing classifier output schema; new overlay agents (those are additive registry edits).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a classifier output flagging the security overlay without a corresponding `security-redteam-findings.json` artifact triggers the verifier block.
  ← Satisfies: "SC1 — overlay-dispatch verification"
- When this story is complete, the overlay registry file lists each supported overlay (security, performance, test_quality, accessibility) with its findings file naming; the verifier reads from the registry.
  ← Satisfies: "SC1 — overlay registry (additive extensibility)"
- When this story is complete, a regression test reproduces the failure surface of bug 94e8-9f91 (overlay flags emitted by classifier; orchestrator ignores them) and confirms the verifier mechanically prevents it.
  ← Satisfies: "SC6 — bug 94e8-9f91 mechanically prevented"
- When this story is complete, when a new overlay agent is added (e.g., accessibility per `cbea-3722`), the registry update is the only change required — no verifier code changes.
  ← Satisfies: extensibility invariant
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic.
  ← Satisfies: TDD Done-of-Done

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Overlay verification must work with stateful re-review (`dbbc-cf67-8cfc-4b4d`) reading the latest review cycle's classifier output and findings files; multi-cycle state must not produce false-positive missing-findings blocks.
- [Maintainability] When `cbea-3722` accessibility reviewer is added to REVIEW Step 4b, registry update plus its findings file naming convention are the only changes required.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
